Title: Admins' Microsoft Defender XDR advanced hunting queries that contain a customer-defined function fail

User impact: Admins' Microsoft Defender XDR advanced hunting queries that contain a customer-defined function fail.

More info: All advanced hunting queries that contain a customer-defined function fail, including custom detection, public API and portal.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft Defender XDR and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Admins' Microsoft Defender XDR advanced hunting queries that contain a customer-defined function may fail

User impact: Admins' Microsoft Defender XDR advanced hunting queries that contain a customer-defined function may fail.

More info: All advanced hunting queries that contain a customer-defined function may fail, including custom detection, public API, and portal.

Current status: We've identified a recent deployment which introduced a code conflict that's resulting in Defender advanced hunting queries that contain a customer-defined function to fail. We're analyzing the deployed code and internal documentation to help us determine our next steps.

Scope of impact: This issue may impact any user who is attempting to run an advanced hunting query that contains a customer-defined function, which may include custom detection, public API, and portal.

Start time: Monday, October 26, 2026, at 4:54 PM UTC

Root cause: A recent deployment intended to bolster service functionality introduced a conflict, which resulted in advanced hunting queries that contain customer-defined functions to fail.

Next update by: Monday, October 26, 2026, at 8:30 PM UTC
